params.name: StartDate
params.description:
Filters based On ArrivedOn date of the metadata File.
ISO-8601 Examples:
UTC datetime: 2022-03-18T21:52:26
UTC datetime with milliseconds: 2022-03-18T21:52:26.8816090Z
UTC date only: 2022-03-19
datetime with timezone: 2022-03-18T17:56:09.8683110-04:00

params.name: EndDate
params.description:
Filters based On ArrivedOn date of the metadata File. Must be equal to or later than StartDate.
ISO-8601 Examples:
UTC datetime: 2022-03-18T21:52:26
UTC datetime with milliseconds: 2022-03-18T21:52:26.8816090Z
UTC date only: 2022-03-19
datetime with timezone: 2022-03-18T17:56:09.8683110-04:00

params.name: MediaType
params.description:
Valid Options:
- Audio,
- Email,
- Chat,
- Video,
- Live,
- Metadata,
- ProcessedChat
- MetadataExtended

params.name: ClientCallId
params.description: Comma-separated list of your system's call identifiers. Up to 100 supported per request.

params.name: LastId
params.description: GUID of the last result from the previous page. Used for cursor-based pagination.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Maximum number of metadata objects returned per call.

params.name: HierarchyIds
params.description: Comma-delimited list of hierarchy IDs (GUIDs) to filter by organizational structure. Cannot be used with Chat, Metadata, or MetadataExtended media types as those files are not assigned to a hierarchy.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the metadata object to update
